generator.name: PCPRI (Phase-Coherent Pseudorandom Recursive Input)
generator.implementation: line-for-line Rust port of the pcpri generator core (state, branch operators, conductor, phase analyzer, feedback extraction), as ported into gwild/data_walker in PR #1 at commit 61953b3077cdf430eb0b0e03e87765f2db3980b6 (under review, not merged as of 2026-11-07; data_walker_rs/src/converters/math/pcpri.rs)
generator.fidelity: port verified step-identical against the original crate: conductor value, feedback word, branch choice, and packed state bytes matched on every one of 3,600 steps across 3 configurations

run.notes: All four streams are aligned on the same post-warm-up steps 256..4351. conductor_full.json additionally records the conductor from step 0 (4352 values) because its warm-up ramp is itself signal. During warm-up the feedback word is identically zero and the state never leaves its all-zero initial value, so no feedback/state/branch data is recorded for those steps.

conductor.json.description: conductor value c in [-1,1] per step, aligned with feedback/state/branch

conductor_full.json.description: conductor value from step 0 including the warm-up ramp, 4352 values

feedback.json.description: feedback word z per step, 16-digit hex (canonical text form; little-endian u64 bytes hash e171a4a4712b4cb3b229c1a39eee83a9557edc65118244eb6f43ab37e7540659)

branch.json.description: branch operator index chosen per step

state.hex.description: packed state per step, one 64-char hex line per step (32 bytes, MSB-first per byte). The packed bytes themselves hash to 77e85dd6c2a28bea13f7f787cd27263025e3dec21876fffcabf834bc7d2ff5a4.

provenance: Generated by Muse at Gregory Wildes' direction, 2026-11-07. Data is computed by the generator, not measured and not synthetic filler: every value is the output of the PCPRI recursion under the recorded config.
